rawFindings.title: Incorrect 'is.home' helper behavior for 'index.html' path
rawFindings.explanation: The updated 'isHomeHelper' function no longer returns true for 'path === "index.html"'. Previously, it returned true if path was falsy or equal to 'index.html'. This change breaks expected behavior for 'index.html' path, causing the helper to return false incorrectly.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the condition to check for both empty string and 'index.html': if (!this.path || this.path === 'index.html') return true;

rawFindings.title: Incorrect detection of home path when empty string
rawFindings.explanation: The original code assigned 'this.path' to a local variable 'path' (line 25) and used it in the function, but the patch removes the declaration and directly uses 'this.path' in condition and regex testing. However, the empty string path check is simplified to only 'this.path === ""', which changes behavior from the original check that also considered 'index.html' path. This might incorrectly make the home check false for 'index.html' path, a common home page variant.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore check to include 'index.html' path, e.g. 'if (!this.path || this.path === "index.html") return true;' to maintain compatibility with existing behavior.

rawFindings.title: Regex for home pagination path updated to an incomplete match
rawFindings.explanation: The regex for pagination path in home pages originally matched '^' + paginationDir + '\/\d+\/(index\.html)?$' (with optional 'index.html' at end). The patch changes it to '^' + paginationDir + '\/\d+\/', which may match undesired paths since it no longer anchors to end of string and excludes optional 'index.html', possibly causing false positives.
rawFindings.suggestion: Keep the original regex or ensure the new regex correctly matches end of string and optional 'index.html' exactly, e.g., '^' + escapeRegExp(paginationDir) + '\/\d+\/(index\.html)?$'.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect isHomeHelper behavior when path is empty string or 'index.html'
rawFindings.explanation: The original code returned true for both empty string and 'index.html' paths in isHomeHelper. The changed code returns true only when this.path is an empty string, removing the condition for 'index.html', which may break expected behavior for 'index.html' path indicating the home page.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the condition to return true when path is empty string or 'index.html'. Replace if (this.path === '') with if (!this.path || this.path === 'index.html') or equivalent.
